strings.about.credit_fonts: Karantina and IBM Plex Sans Hebrew, under the OFL license.
strings.about.credit_mta: The official MTA map was used only to identify run names and colors, and was not copied.
strings.about.credit_videos: They belong to their creators on YouTube and are only embedded.
strings.about.display_sub: Auto by the time in Gudauri, day or night
strings.about.haptics_sub: On phones that support it (not iPhone)
strings.about.language_hint: Each language is written in its own script, so everyone finds theirs. The choice stays on this phone.
strings.about.language_manual: Chosen here, saved on this phone
strings.about.reset_confirm: Sure? Tap again to delete all best scores
strings.about.reset_sub: Best scores are saved only on this phone
strings.about.setting_saved: Setting saved. In a game that's already open, it applies next time you enter
strings.about.sound_sub: In the boarding pass and the games
strings.about.unofficial: An unofficial site and app, not affiliated with MTA.
strings.daynight.button_aria: Display mode: {mode}. Tap to switch to {next}
strings.games.descent_long: Ride the real profile of Gudauri's runs, pick up the crew and outrun the avalanche. Hold to crouch, release to jump.
strings.games.descent_tag: The descent on the real runs
strings.games.fresh_long: Finger, boot, skis or snowcat, with the sound of powder, crust and wet snow.
strings.games.fresh_tag: Touch the snow and smash a frozen lake
strings.games.intro: On Gudauri's snow. Best scores stay on your phone only, and sound is recommended.
strings.games.merge_long: Swipe, and two identical balls merge into a bigger one.
strings.games.merge_tag: From a snowflake to the King of Kazbek
strings.games.school_long: Seven lessons. Each has one principle and a drill built for it, with a coach who tells you what's happening.
strings.games.snowball_long: Duck behind the wall, stand up, aim and throw. The whole arena is always in front of you.
strings.games.snowball_tag: Behind the wall, against the crew
strings.home.app_req: Works on Android 8.0 and up. The app uses the same data as the site.
strings.home.app_step1: Download the file on your phone.
strings.home.app_step2: Open it, and allow the install when your phone asks about installing from an unknown source.
strings.home.board_games_sub: The Descent, Ski School, Fresh Snow and more
strings.home.board_meet_sub: Pick a station and a time, send it to the group
strings.home.load_error: Couldn't load the site. Try refreshing the page.
strings.lift.runs_to_bottom_heading: Runs ending at the bottom station
strings.lift.stations_value: {bot} m at the bottom, {top} m at the top
strings.map.compass: Rotate back to the view from the south
strings.map.hint_mouse: Drag: rotate · Wheel: zoom · Right button: pan
strings.map.hint_touch: One finger: rotate · Two: zoom and pan
strings.map.kobi_map_aria: North side map: Kobi run and Kobi lifts
strings.map.kobi_note: The northern descent from Kobi Pass to Kobi village. Smaller scale than the main map.
strings.map.map3d_aria: 3D model of the mountain with the runs and lifts. Drag to rotate, wheel or pinch to zoom.
strings.map.map_aria: Run and lift map of Gudauri
strings.map.overview_3d_controls_hint: In 3D: drag to rotate, scroll or pinch to zoom, right-click or two fingers to pan the map.
strings.map.overview_lead: Tap a run on the map or in the list for details and videos. A thin dashed line is an unnamed section in the data, and a blue dashed line is a ski way. The northern Kobi side opens from the button in the corner of the map.
strings.map.overview_missing_count: On the official map, missing from the data · {n}
strings.map.overview_partial_hint: Runs where only part of the line, or only the center line, was found. Each one's details say what was found, where from and how confident we are. We didn't draw the missing parts, so as not to guess.
strings.map.overview_source_text: Lines: OpenStreetMap via Overpass, fetched {fetched}. Names and colors follow the official Gudauri map (MTA). Horizontal lengths from the coordinates. Relief and altitudes: Terrarium elevation tiles (AWS Open Data, mostly SRTM). Peaks: names and altitudes from the official map, positions from OSM. The village, roads and lake: OSM. Filling in the missing runs: OSM edit history and public GPS tracks (api.openstreetmap.org), {research_date}. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
strings.meet.empty_body: Pick a station on the map, or a fixed spot above, and the card will be printed here.
strings.meet.hint_clear: Tap an empty spot on the map, or the pin again, to clear the choice
strings.meet.hint_pick: Where are we meeting? Tap one of the {n} stations
strings.meet.map_aria: Map of lift stations. Tap a pin to choose a meeting point
strings.meet.no_db: No database and no sign-up: the place, day and time live inside the link itself.
strings.meet.routes_empty: No run in the data leads here.
strings.meet.routes_hint: Based on the connections in the run data. No times and no queues.
strings.meta.description: Prep site for a ski trip to Gudauri, Georgia: run and lift map, a 3D model of the mountain and details on every run.
strings.meta.og_description: Run and lift map, a 3D model of the mountain and details on every run.
strings.meta.title: Gudauri 2027: trip prep site
strings.run.compare_line: About as steep as {steep_run} About as long as {long_run}
strings.run.connections_hint: Worked out from how close the line ends are (up to 200 m to a station, 60 m to a run). Worth checking against the official map.
strings.run.elevation_accuracy_hint: Altitudes from the terrain model (about 30 m resolution), accurate to roughly ±15 m.
strings.run.missing_notice: This run is on the official map, but it has no line in the OpenStreetMap data. We didn't draw it, so as not to guess the route.
strings.run.note_area_polygon: Also includes a run area (polygon) that is not counted in the length.
strings.run.note_beginner_area: Beginner area. Shown as its center line.
strings.run.note_firni_unclear: In OSM the line is called "Frini", with no number. The official map has Firni 1 and Firni 2, and it's unclear which one this line belongs to. The other one is missing from the data.
strings.run.note_lit: Marked as lit in the evening.
strings.run.note_osm_grade_mismatch: In OSM some sections are graded "{grades}". The color here follows the official map ({color}).
strings.run.note_osm_no_grade: Some sections have no difficulty grade in OSM. The color follows the official map.

run.note_separate_segments.one: {n} separate section in OSM. The length is the sum of the sections.
run.note_separate_segments.other: {n} separate sections in OSM. The length is the sum of the sections.

strings.run.note_ski_way: According to the official map's legend, this is a ski way between areas, not a run.
strings.run.note_unnamed_osm: An unnamed section in the OSM data. Not matched to an official run. The color follows the OSM grade.
strings.run.note_zuma_two_lines: In OSM it appears as two lines, Zuma-1 and Zuma-2. On the official map: Zuma.
strings.run.profile_hint: The terrain up to 150 m from the run is colored with the same legend. Altitudes and gradients come from the elevation model (about 30 m), along the run's longest line. On short walls the real gradient can be steeper.
strings.run.profile_range_aria: Position along the run, top to bottom
strings.run.source_historical: (the way was deleted from OSM in 2024; taken from the edit history)
strings.run.source_osm_named: An OSM way that carried this name
strings.run.source_osm_unnamed_match: An unnamed OSM way, matched by its position on the official map
strings.run.stat_altitude_value: {top} m at the top, {bot} m at the bottom
strings.run.videos_empty: No videos for this run yet.
strings.status.board_hint: Source: the MTA status page. A run is marked open only if a lift to its top is open too. {open} of {total} lifts open.
strings.status.change_closed: {lift} has closed since you last checked
strings.status.change_opened: {lift} has opened since you last checked
strings.status.lead_in_season: There's no recent lift report from MTA right now. The map is shown as usual.
strings.status.lead_off_season: No lift reports yet. The Gudauri season usually opens in December, and then the signs will be cleared of snow.
strings.status.no_guessing_text: when there's no recent report, it says so here.
strings.ticket.hint_swap: Tap the pass behind to switch ·
strings.ticket.hint_tear: Tap the stub to tear it off
strings.ticket.swap_out: Bring the outbound pass to the front
strings.ticket.swap_return: Bring the return pass to the front
strings.trip.bad_order: The return is before the outbound
strings.trip.lead: Only the outbound date is required. No sign-up: saved only in this browser.
strings.trip.local_note: No sign-up. Saved only in this browser, and you can delete it any time.
strings.trip.ski_computed: Full ski days, worked out from the flights
strings.trip.ski_manual: Full ski days, set by hand
strings.trip.ski_unknown: Worked out from the return date
